headline: China’s CAC launches a unified filing system for internet technology services
summary: On 2026-11-09, China’s Cyberspace Administration said its new Internet New Technology and Application Information Service Filing System had entered operation. The notice says the system integrates filings for generative AI, algorithms, deep-synthesis services and blockchain, and that the former algorithm-filing and blockchain-service filing systems stopped operating. This records the regulator’s launch announcement; the portal opened without readable page text during this review, so actual workflows and filings were not independently inspected.
